profile.headline: Lead Full Stack Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Floral Park, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I currently work with a SaaS application, hosted on AWS, with Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL on the backend, and React and Redux on the frontend.  We also use GraphQL for some external API integrations.  We follow CI/CD practices with Argo CI, use Docker to manage local development, and Git for version control.
I have experience with Node.js, Python, Django, Java, and Elixir, and can typically pick up a new language in two weeks.

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Powering alternative investments® with the leading order management system (“OMS”) for alternative product transactions.

- Improved application performance by optimizing queries resulting in a 60 fold reduction in loading times.
- Built views of the application where users could customize their experience and invite guests to access a slice of the platform via a magic link.
- Refactored data feed importers reducing import times from a few hours to a few minutes.  
- Built an impersonation feature where customer support staff could more effectively and quickly address client questions.
- Implemented team and role based access controls and an allowed IP feature enabling more than 30 K users to successfully and appropriately access the application.
- Led a team of three engineers, prioritizing tasks, documenting requirements, and sub-tasking feature development.
- Handled production deployments, testing commits, and managing and triaging  incidents.
- Interviewed candidates for technical positions at all levels.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · React.js · PostgreSQL · Ruby on Rails · GraphQL · Sidekiq · Redis

positions.title: Apprentice Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Applied test driven development in creating Ruby and Elixir Tic-Tac-Toe applications with an unbeatable AI.
- Leveraged SOLID principles to build and deploy Java Http and Echo Servers.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Elixir · PostgreSQL · Ruby on Rails · Java

positions.title: Founder, Software Engineer, Physical Therapist
positions.description:
- Established a profitable and five star rated small business administering physical therapy to Medicare beneficiaries. 
- Managed all financial, regulatory, and marketing aspects, including billing and collections, insurance contracts, regulatory documentation, company website, social media pages, blogs, and community outreach.
- Developed technology infrastructure, including the company website, and ongoing efforts such as a HIPAA compliant electronic medical record.

positions.title: Apprentice Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built Ruby and Elixir Tic-Tac-Toe applications, with an unbeatable AI using Minimax algorithm, and CI through Travis and Github Actions.
- Deployed Java Http and Echo Servers to Elastic Beanstalk EC2 instances, using CircleCI for CI/CD.
- Applied SOLID principles, test-driven development, and object-oriented design to build flexible and maintainable applications.

positions.title: Physical Therapist, Supervisor
positions.description:
- Supervised a staff of 14 therapists, and created an on-boarding program to increase retention and quality of patient care.
- Ensured compliance with Medicare guidelines through therapists’ documentation review and mentoring.

company.name: Outreach Physical & Occupational Therapy and Speech Rehabilitation

positions.title: Education and Health Volunteer
positions.description:
- Managed the successful funding, construction and use of 41 household pit latrines to
reduce open defecation and diarrheal incidence in an Upper West region rural village.
- Supported University Research Co.’s implementation of USAID’s Systems for Health
initiative, a collaboration with Ghana Health Service to strengthen the health system.
- Taught JHS Mathematics and Information Communication Technology and managed the
girls’ soccer and netball teams in a village of 3,000 in the Upper West region.
- Enstooled as Queen Mother of Ga, an Upper West region village.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
- Led the cross-functional implementation of an IT platform of workflow processes, data
management and advanced analytics impacting approximately 500 users, with
successful roll-out within schedule and the $3 million budget.
- Managed the cross-functional implementation of an IT platform with a budget of $7
million.
- Supervised a team of six staff, setting the vision and plan for implementation.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
- Managed the cross-functional implementation of the Generic Drug User Fee Act,
redesigning business processes and developing systems to meet performance
commitments.
- Led the cross-functional implementation of the Biosimilar User Fee Act, designing
processes and ensuring systems in place for successful launch by the mandated date.

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
- Implemented an innovative medical management initiative resulting in an estimated
annual net savings of $.5 million for the Medicare Advantage division of a fortune 500
insurance company.

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
- Collaborated with the CFO to implement $3 million in cost reduction supply chain
initiatives for a 250 bed hospital.
- Created a process to estimate the capital planning budget for a 900 bed hospital, and
collaborated with the Treasurer to implement the process.
- Analyzed market, strategic and financial information to create a $500 million value
proposition for a health system.
- Analyzed financial and operational data to create financial models for various
departments of a cardiology institute.
- Assessed market, financial and operational information to determine the optimal
organizational and growth strategy for a cardiovascular department.

positions.title: Business Development Intern
positions.description:
- Analyzed the market size, and the competitive and regulatory managed care
environments in each state to determine the appropriate growth strategy for the Medicare Advantage Special Needs Plan.

- Managed outpatient clinics in Wading River and Wall Street.

projects.title: SmartEMR (React, Apollo, GraphQL, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon CloudFront, Travis CI)
projects.description: A HIPAA compliant electronic medical record for independent physical therapists to document and track client visits.

projects.title: Tasker (React, Redux, JavaScript, Ruby, Rails, PostgreSQL, Webpack, CSS3)
projects.description:
- A single page TaskRabbit clone where users select taskers, and book, view, and cancel tasks.	 
Incorporated React’s virtual DOM and Redux’s global store to seamlessly share and render information across multiple components when booking a task.
- Created Active Record associations to extract tasker data from multiple tables in a single Ajax request, avoiding inefficient database queries and improving user’s experience.
- Authenticated users with React Router and BCrypt, and generated unique session tokens with SecureRandom, allowing logged-in users to only access and make changes to their own tasks.
